findings.summary: Valid string-backed Claude document content is downgraded to JSON text.
findings.failure_scenario: A function_call_output array containing {"type":"document","source":{"type":"content","content":"document"}} is valid under the Claude ContentBlockSource schema, whose content field is string or an array of text/image blocks, but r02 accepts only arrays and falls back the entire tool result to compact JSON text.

schema_reference.verified_contract: ContentBlockSource.content is string or array of ContentBlockSourceContent; array members are text or image blocks.

resolution: Do not apply r02. Mint a corrected immutable revision that preserves string-backed document content and directly tests invalid native image, document, and search-result required fields.
